article_summary: The article evaluates the environmental sustainability of hydropower, solar energy, and wind power, emphasizing that low-carbon energy sources can still cause greenhouse-gas emissions, intensive land and water use, habitat loss, and biodiversity damage. It highlights the importance of considering full ecological impacts when selecting energy sources and recommends careful siting, design, impact assessment, and mitigation to ensure that renewable-energy development is genuinely green. These concepts can support environmental awareness when designing smart-home rules that favor electricity from lower-impact renewable sources.
